segments.name: ADC development
segments.description: A clinical stage oncology business developing site-specific and novel-format antibody drug conjugates for cancer patients.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one business segment that focuses on developing site-specific and novel-format ADCs.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by pharmaceutical and biotechnology collaboration partners for drug discovery, development and licensing of product candidates created with its platforms.
revenueModel.evidence: Through December 31, 2025, we have received an aggregate of approximately $1.016 billion in payments from all of our collaborations, which includes approximately $79 million in investments in our stock.

changes.text: In 2025, the company terminated development of luveltamab tazevibulin (luvelta) after a strategic portfolio review.
changes.evidence: Following this review, we made the strategic decision to deprioritize additional investment into luvelta development, and development has since been terminated.

dropped: change not grounded: In 2025, the exclusive license agreement with Ipsen for STRO-003 was terminated.
